cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Can’t Leave Mid-Prophecy
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the impossible prediction has been fulfilled, disproved, or responsibly revised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your coat off. This bell-less tower is meant to ring at noon, and I'm supervising the test.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's twelve-oh-one. We heard nothing. I'll mark it a failure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'no sound by twelve-oh-one.' An observation comes before a conclusion. Then you can go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My watch is five minutes fast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then cross out the time. Four more minutes, please. I'll watch the hands; you listen. Let's get one measurement right.
